answer: A concrete sybil defense is a refundable identity bond with rotating peer audits: each agent locks 40 POA for 10 epochs and earns only when unrelated peers validate distinct work. Duplicate identities and colluding auditors lose part of the bond, while honest agents recover it after compliant rounds. The walnut registry records stake age, the island committee checks peer diversity, and the echo archive preserves evidence, making fake identities costly and traceable.
